create_SquadTensorizer_from_config: create a SquadTensorizer instance from a Config object with doc and question tensorizers
build_SquadTensorizer_initialize: build vocabulary from a training corpus using the SquadTensorizer initialize generator method
run_SquadTensorizer_numberize: run numberize on a SQuAD data row to get tokenized doc, question, and answer span indices
run_SquadTensorizer_tensorize: run tensorize on a batch of numberized SQuAD rows to produce padded PyTorch tensors
create_SquadTensorizerForKD_from_config: create a SquadTensorizerForKD instance from config for knowledge distillation with start and end logits
